notes.dedup_rule: results are keyed by (track, card_date, race, pick); when a key has more than one entry the later, authoritatively-sourced entry is effective and the earlier provisional one is retained as history
notes.totals_unchanged: the canonical reader always counted each key once, so these totals are identical to those published before the supersessions were declared explicitly
notes.selections: one row per published flag, newest last, joined to its grade by (track, date, race, program); status is PENDING until the chart is read. fair_odds_decimal is the reference price we required, board_ml_decimal is the morning line, closing_decimal_odds is what the tote paid. flat_pl_units is a flat $2 win bet, and a VOID carries no stake
